The Police Sub-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused for the offences punishable U/s.498A,506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Devika K.
The gist of the  3  C.C.No.5850/2021 prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 got married with CW-1 on 19-12-2016.

As per accused demand, the parents of CW-1 had given in 120 gms of gold ornaments and 750 Gms Silver items and cash of Rs.4 lakhs given to the Accused No.1 and performed the marriage by incurring Rs.15 lakhs.
That Accused No.1 to 5 in furtherance of their common intention while residing at Chitradurga harassed CW-1 to get more dowry from her parents house.
After the marriage, CW-1 started residing with the Accused No.1 to 5 at H.No.117, 7th main, Srinivasanagar, Bangalore

at that Devika K vs Vittal R on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78806685/
2 time, the Accused No.1 picked quarrel with CW-1 to bring Rs.Five lakhs dowry from her parents house to meet debts taken by his father.

sentences.text:
When CW-1 refused to do so, at the instigation of Accused No.2 to 5, the Accused No.1 used to assault, abuse, and tried to slit her neck and told her to listen to him, threatening her,
unnecessarily suspecting her and drove away her out of his house.

Depite convening a panchayath, Accused No.2 to 5 induced Accused No.1 to do ill will acts against CW1 causing insult to her and thus subjected CW-1 to cruelty both physically and mentally in demand of additional dowry .Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.85/2020 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

The plea of the accused was recorded.

sentences.text: In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused person caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and thereby accused has committed the offence  punishable U/s.498A,506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry  Prohibition Act..?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex. P.2
is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Devika.

She in her Devika K vs Vittal R on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78806685/
4 examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused  6  C.C.No.5850/2021 No.1 was performed on 19-12-2016 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry. PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.

sentences.text: There the police took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge  7  C.C.No.5850/2021 sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile the Devika K vs Vittal R on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78806685/
5 prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.

 ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under and 5 are acquitted of the offence punishable U/s.498A,506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
